tool: arXiv API (export.arxiv.org/api/query, sortBy=submittedDate) via the agent fetch tool
purpose: query-adaptive probe budgeting for the binary LSH index — the query-side companion to the Round-15 bit-reliability model (memory/bitweight.js) and margin multi-probe (memory/multiprobe.js)

headline.title: Cardinality Estimation for High Dimensional Similarity Queries with Adaptive Bucket Probing
headline.note: Adopts classical multi-probe LSH but explores neighbouring buckets with a budget adapted to the query and the distance threshold; the direct grounding for a per-query probe depth in memory/multiprobe.js.

headline.title: NeuRoute: Logit-Guided Neural Routing for Billion-Scale Vector Search with Sub-Hour Index Construction
headline.note: The query logits are an uncertainty signal: perturb only the bits the query is least sure of. Round-15 lead, implemented this round with the uncertainty read off the exact flip law instead of a learned head.

headline.title: Query-Adaptive Hash Code Ranking for Large-Scale Multi-View Visual Search
headline.note: Query-adaptive bitwise/tablewise weighting for RANKING — the sibling idea; not adopted because the Round-15 recorded negative shows weighted ranking does not beat plain Hamming on the rotation-based index.

supporting.title: Constant Sequence Extension for Fast Search Using Weighted Hamming Distance
supporting.note: Query-adaptive per-bit weights for WHD ranking, with a linear-time bucket-sequence extension — relevant if weighted ranking is ever revisited.

supporting.title: MP-RW-LSH: An Efficient Multi-Probe LSH Solution to ANNS in L1 Distance
supporting.note: Multi-probe for L1; explains why some LSH families resist multi-probe extension. Context for the margin-order requirement.

supporting.title: Dynamic Query Modification for Binary Locality Sensitive Hashing
supporting.note: The other open item-2 piece: change the query at query time using search feedback. Still unwired.

verdict: Implemented as the default-off query-adaptive probe budget (adaptiveMultiProbeConfig): exact Poisson-binomial flip count, exact containment and recovery coverages, single-pass recovery depth, exhaustive enumeration over the probed depth, and sigma calibration from an observed Hamming distance. See docs/LOCKED.md and docs/research/lsh-ann.md.
